Text:
# CORYNEBACTERIUM SPP.

Optimal therapy depends on both the disease or syndrome and the pathogen. See disease/syndrome sections for more information.

---

References:

- Sanford Guide article: Corynebacterium diptheriae
- Sanford Guide article: Corynebacterium jeikeium
- Up-To-Date article: Clinical manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment of diptheria
Therapy:
## For Corynebacterium diphtheriae isolates, contact Infectious Diseases

## Corynebacterium jeikeium

Preferred:
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h R

Alternative (for vancomycin intolerance):
Daptomycin 4-6 mg/kg IV q24h R
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU GRAM-POS FI CORYNEBACTERIUM SPP.
